checklist.signIn: Sign-in (before sedation or anaesthesia): identity, consent, the treated side, allergies and fasting confirmed.
checklist.timeOut: Time-out (before the first needle): the whole team agrees the patient, the target, the side, the number of needles and the images on screen.
checklist.signOut: Sign-out (before the patient leaves the CT room): what was done, the counts and the plan for recovery stated.

card.title: Meet the devices
card.robot: A needle-guidance robot like Perfint MAXIO or Quantum Surgical Epione: it aims a guide along each planned path, and the radiologist pushes the needle through it.
card.console: An argon cryoablation system like Boston Scientific Visual-ICE: it runs several needles at once, freezes their tips to about -150 °C, and thaws them actively at the end.
card.honesty: Simulated. The robot aims the guide to about 1-2 mm (the makers' figure); the needle is then pushed in by hand and its tip can land several millimetres off the plan (6 mm in one robot-guided lung series), so it is checked on CT. Robot plus cryoablation is still an emerging combination, and the times and temperatures here are illustrative.
